note: Two reusable rules emerged from the review findings: one about centralizing API configuration and one about reusing OAuth initiation states.

candidates.text: Keep the API base URL and similar endpoint configuration in a single exported frontend constant; do not duplicate it across route modules.
candidates.rationale: The calendar OAuth callback page redefined apiBaseUrl locally, creating a second source of truth that can drift when the backend URL changes. Centralizing it matches the existing shared-api pattern and prevents maintenance bugs.

candidates.text: OAuth account-link flows should reuse a valid, unconsumed initiation state for the same user/session instead of generating a new state row on every page load.
candidates.rationale: The calendar status endpoint created a fresh OAuth state on every load, leading to unconsumed state-row proliferation. Reusing recent pending states reduces database noise while preserving the existing state-verification safety check.
